headlines.title: 'K-국부펀드' 설립 논의 시작 …" 상반기 중 방안 마련 "
headlines.summary: 재경부, 한국판 국부펀드 설립 방향 논의 위한 간담회 "유망산업에 장기 지분 투자…미래 세대와 국부 나눌 것" "상반기 중 설립 방안 마련하고 국회에 법안 제출 예정" [세종=뉴시스] 강종민 기자 = 세종시 어진동 정부세종청사 재정경제부. 2026.01.06. ppkjm@newsis.

headlines.title: 임광현 국세청장 “ 다주택자 편법 증여, 가산세 40% 물 수도 ”
headlines.summary: SNS 통해 편법증여 전수 검증 예고 “정상이면 양도가 증여보다 부담적어” 다음달 9일 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예가 종료되는 가운데 임광현 국세청장이 29일 세금을 피하기 위한 다주택자들의 편법 증여를 철저하게 검증하겠다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 서울 60㎡ 이하 소형 아파트 평균가 10억 넘었다
headlines.summary: 대출 규제·전세난에 중저가 매수 쏠림 6개월새 11%↑, 모든 면적 중 상승률 최고 “구매력 부족 실수요자, 작은 아파트 몰려” 서울의 60㎡ 이하 소형 아파트 평균 가격이 처음으로 10억원을 돌파했다. 대출 한도 축소가 덜한 중저가 아파트로 매수세가 모이며, ‘좁은 집’의 몸값이 폭등하고 있는 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 정부 ‘ 건설사 구하기 ’… 표준단가 공시 연기
headlines.summary: 예년보다 일주일 늦춰 내달 8일 중동전쟁 여파 물가인상분 반영 중동전쟁 장기화에 따른 공사비 급등으로 건설사들의 부담이 커지자 정부가 건설사 구하기에 나섰다. 올해 하반기 발주될 공공 공사의 표준 단가 발표 시기를 일주일가량 연기해 전쟁에 따른 물가 인상분을 최대한 반영하기로 한 것이다.

headlines.title: 나프타 보조금에 업계 ‘ 숨통 ’… 스폿 물량 확보
headlines.summary: 여천NCC 가동률 55 → 65% 극단적인 공급절벽 상황 완화 원료값 비싸 ‘역마진’은 여전 미국·이란 전쟁발 나프타 수급난에 직격탄을 맞았던 국내 석유화학기업들이 나프타분해시설(NCC) 가동률을 높이면서 극한 위기 상황은 넘어간 것으로 분석됐다.

headlines.title: 중동사태에 기업들 투자 미루고 부채상환
headlines.summary: 지난달 회사채 잔액 0.2% 감소 발행 목적도 차환 용도가 85% 시설 투자 위한 발행액은 ‘제로’ 중동 전쟁과 고금리 여파로 불확실성이 커지면서 기업들이 미래를 위한 투자보다는 당장의 생존을 위해 부채 상환에 주력하는 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 원전 업계, 해외 진출 경험 부족... 정부 "첫걸음 지원 강화 "
headlines.summary: <연합뉴스> 정부가 원전 수출 업계를 돕기 위해 해외인증 취득 등 수출지원사업을 확대한다. 수출실적이 부족한 중소·중견기업엔 '수출 첫걸음 지원정책'을 강화한다. 산업통상자원부는 20일 한국원전수출산업협회와 공동으로 '원전 기업을 위한 수출 설명회'를 갖고 이같이 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 뽑겠다는 중기, 일하겠다는 외국인 … 현장선 ‘ 미스매치 ’ 심각
headlines.summary: 중진공, 중기·유학생 대상 조사 기업·외국인 약 80% ‘채용·취업 희망’ 정부·지자체, 공공 취업매칭 강화 필요 네팔에서 온 외국인 근로자들이 인천국제공항 제2터미널을 통해 입국하고 있다.  [뉴시스] 중소기업 10곳 중 8곳가량은 외국인 유학생과 구직자를 채용할 의향이 있는 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 女 가사노동 가치 연 1천650만원 … 성별 격차 3.2→2.7배로 축소

headlines.title: 돈 안 받는 집안일도 GDP 23% 규모 … 582조 가치

headlines.title: 60세 이상 정년연장시 임금 조정 …재계 ‘연령차별 예외’ 法명시 요구...

key_headlines.title: Government to Establish Korean Sovereign Wealth Fund by H1 2026
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's finance ministry announced plans to establish a sovereign wealth fund for long-term investments in promising industries, with legislative proposals expected by mid-2026. The fund aims to share national wealth with future generations through strategic equity investments.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Small Apartments Under 60 sq meters Cross 1 Billion Won Threshold
key_headlines.summary: Small apartments in Seoul surpassed 1 billion won in average price for the first time, rising 11% in six months due to stricter lending regulations concentrating buyer demand in affordable mid-range properties. This marks the highest appreciation rate among all apartment sizes.

key_headlines.title: Tax Authority Vows Strict Crackdown on Multi-Property Owners' Tax Evasion Schemes
key_headlines.summary: National Tax Service Commissioner announced comprehensive verification of illegal gift transfers by multi-property owners ahead of the capital gains tax moratorium expiration on May 9, with penalties up to 40% surcharge possible. The crackdown aims to prevent tax avoidance strategies.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Surpasses 6,600 Barrier as Total Market Cap Exceeds 6,000 Trillion Won
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's stock market reached a historic milestone with KOSPI breaching 6,600 and combined KOSPI-KOSDAQ market capitalization exceeding 6,000 trillion won for the first time. Semiconductor stocks, particularly SK Hynix hitting record highs, led the rally.

key_headlines.title: Government Delays Public Construction Standard Price Announcement to Reflect War-Related Price Hikes
key_headlines.summary: The government postponed the announcement of standard construction costs for H2 public projects by one week to reflect inflation from ongoing Middle East conflict and supply chain disruptions. The measure aims to ease financial burden on construction companies facing soaring material costs.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea announced plans to establish a sovereign wealth fund for long-term strategic investments in promising industries by mid-2026. Seoul's small apartment market surpassed 1 billion won in average price for the first time, with prices rising 11% in six months as stricter lending regulations concentrate buyer demand in affordable segments. The National Tax Service vowed strict enforcement against multi-property owners' tax evasion schemes ahead of the May 9 capital gains tax moratorium expiration. The government delayed public construction cost announcements to account for Middle East conflict-related inflation. Korean petrochemical companies also showed recovery signs as naphtha supply constraints began easing.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Debate continues over Korea's monetary policy stance, with discussions on adequately reflecting real inflation pressures in policy decisions rather than relying on distorted price indicators. JP Morgan CEO Jamie Dimon warned that rising government debt levels could trigger a bond market crisis and credit risk during recessions. Trump's approval ratings fell to 34%, a record low during his presidency, attributed to Iran war-related inflation and rising oil prices. Korea's first quarter small and medium enterprise exports reached a record 2.98 billion dollars, driven by cosmetics and semiconductors, though some markets showed contraction. Gyeonggi province commenced fiscal settlement inspections covering comprehensive budget operations and fund management.
sections.Financial Markets: KOSPI rose 2.15% to 6,615.03 as semiconductor stocks led gains, with SK Hynix hitting record highs above 1.29 million won and Samsung Electronics surpassing 220,000 won. Combined KOSPI-KOSDAQ market capitalization exceeded 6,000 trillion won for the first time. KB Kookmin Bank issued 700 million dollars in senior global bonds at record-low spreads. Shinhan Asset Management launched the Shinhan SOL KOSDAQ 150 Index Fund featuring ultra-competitive 0.09% annual management fees. The Korean won strengthened to 1,472.5 against the dollar as market sentiment improved despite Fed policy uncertainty.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korea launched the K-Pharma-Bio unified support initiative applying successful national branding strategies from semiconductors and defense sectors to pharmaceutical-biotech exports. The government restructured electric vehicle public charging fees from 2 to 5 tiers, reducing slow-charging costs from 324.4 to 294.3 won per kilowatt-hour to reflect actual operating cost differences. US data center power equipment expenditure is projected to reach 65 billion dollars by 2030 amid AI infrastructure competition, creating opportunities for Korean power equipment manufacturers. Naphtha cracking facility utilization improved from 55% to 65% as supply constraints eased, though raw material costs remain elevated.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's small apartments under 60 square meters surpassed 1 billion won average price, rising 11% in six months as lending restrictions concentrated demand in this segment. The government tightened rental deposit guarantee requirements effective July, limiting jeonse (lease deposit) prices to 130.5% of official appraisal values. Public housing consultations increased 112.6%, particularly regarding apartment pre-payment loan interest rates. The government announced 3,100 public housing units for subscription in the metropolitan area starting April 30, including units in Third New Towns. Seoul introduced development incentives allowing higher floor-area ratios for private redevelopment and reconstruction projects to expand housing supply.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve is expected to hold its benchmark interest rate at 3.5-3.75% at the FOMC meeting ending April 29. Fed Chairman Jerome Powell's tenure ends May 15, with uncertainty about whether he will retain his board position for the remaining two years of his term. Bitcoin declined to 76,000 dollars amid FOMC uncertainty and broader economic concerns. Over 70 US Democratic House representatives urged President Trump to ban Chinese automaker production and sales in America, citing threats to US manufacturing and national security. Global crypto card payments surpassed 1.7 billion dollars cumulatively in 2026.
sections.AI & Economy: US data center power equipment spending is projected to reach 65 billion dollars by 2030 as AI infrastructure competition accelerates, benefiting Korean power equipment manufacturers including Hyosung Heavy Industries, LS Electric, and HD Hyundai. OpenAI's disappointing earnings results reignited AI investment bubble concerns, pressuring Nasdaq index 0.9% lower as investors questioned profitability of massive AI infrastructure investments. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are positioned to capitalize on NAND flash memory demand surge alongside their HBM dominance as AI data center expansion continues. Companies increasingly focus on token consumption optimization as AI operating costs become critical competitive factors in enterprise operations. AI infrastructure investment returns and big tech earnings reports emerged as key market variables determining sector momentum.
sections.Others: NH-Amundi Asset Management surpassed 100 trillion won in total assets under management, marking historic growth of approximately 30 trillion won over one year. Hanwha Asset Management's PLUS Solar & ESS exchange-traded fund surpassed 2 billion won in net assets within one month, recording 112% returns over three months. Market sentiment shifted on OpenAI earnings disappointment with focus turning to Google and Meta earnings announcements on April 29 to gauge AI investment viability. Incheon Mayor Yu Jung-bok announced re-election candidacy, highlighting economic indicators and fiscal health improvements over his four-year tenure. White House Correspondents' Association dinner shooting incident sparked debate over free expression versus public safety concerns.
